question: From what date must ministry departments run their work on the e-office system?
gold_answer: From 01-04-2023, per the standard operating procedure circular of 23-02-2023 (which cites a circular of 02-02-2023 not in this corpus). The 2020 mahaeoffice GR and SOP (19-10-2020, 09-11-2020) came earlier

The 09-11-2020 GR fixes the SOP for this implementation but does not state a new compliance date for ministry departments. The 23-02-2023 GR states that e-office system use must be made effective from 01-04-2023 in all ministry administrative departments and regional offices, and that e-postal/e-holidays must be sent through e-office from that date, with physical mail sent only by hand where e-office is not possible. No newer GR in the corpus amends, replaces, stays, extends or clarifies the 19-10-2020 GR; the 2023 GR concerns SOP procedure rather than the original directive date.
